title: When a crack becomes critical
caption: The stress intensity K = Yσ√(πa) rises with the crack length a. At σ = 200 MPa it reaches the steel's toughness K_IC = 50 MPa √m when a = 15.9 mm: any longer and the plate fractures. At half the crack length K is only 35 MPa √m.
alt: Graph of stress intensity against crack length in millimetres: a rising square-root curve crossing the horizontal toughness line at 50 MPa root metre at a crack length of 15.9 millimetres.
description: The horizontal axis is the edge-crack length a in mm; the vertical axis is K in MPa √m.
K = Yσ√(πa) with Y = 1.12 and σ = 200 MPa rises as the square root of a.
The dashed line is the toughness K_IC = 50 MPa √m.

checks.name: K reaches K_IC at a = 15.9 mm
